thread:
Elena: Heads up — Big FinTech partner flagged that they can't reason about cost per route. They want per-route + token breakdown before beta cut.

Matt: That matches what Support saw. If we ship only aggregate costs they'd bounce.

Sophia: Do we have a perf budget? Per-route breakdown adds instrumentation and query costs. Rough estimate: +10-15% to telemetry ingestion for 30d retention.

Jon: Proposed cut: implement server-side sampling + on-demand full traces. MVP: top 20 routes cost and top 10 traces per route.

Caroline: Launch criteria suggestion: (1) per-route cost in Console, (2) trace hooks enabled for pinned routes, (3) error heatmap + drift alerting, (4) docs for customers to opt-in.

Elena: +1. Also need rollout plan — feature flag and canary to 3 enterprise accounts. We should hide from hosted free tier.

Matt: Tracing hooks — need standard tag schema: route, model_id, quantization_profile. Add `trace.enable=true` at route config. Example:
```
routes:
  - name: checkout
    trace:
      enable: true
      sample_rate: 0.1
```

Sophia: For cost, suggest new metric `tokens.per_route` and `token_cost.cents`. Backend: aggregate by route_id hourly, store 90d.

Jon: Ops asks: retention 90d might spike S3 costs. Can we do hot-window 7d analytic store + archived hourly files?

Caroline: Yes, propose hot window 7d, archive 83d compressed on object storage. Add quota guardrails so customers can't accidentally explode cost.

Elena: Customer asks also included regression alerting — compare baseline error rates per route over 7d. If >2x and >0.5% abs, trigger ticket.

Matt: UX: dashboard tile suggestions: 1) Top cost routes table, 2) Error heatmap, 3) Trace waterfall for selected request, 4) Model perf vs quantization profile.

Sophia: Dev effort rough: backend 6 sprint-weeks, runtime changes 2 sprint-weeks, console + UX 3 sprint-weeks, docs + rollout 1 sprint-week. Total ~12 sprint-weeks (parallelizable).

Jon: Prioritization: Customer-impacted (3 enterprise) => P0; others P1. I'd cut per-request trace retention to 24h for MVP if we need to shorten.

Caroline: Need acceptance criteria per feature: per-route cost shows correct numbers for historical 14d; trace hooks attach route/model metadata; error alerts fire in staging with injected anomalies.

Elena: Action items: @Matt scope backend schemas; @Sophia estimate infra cost delta; @Jon test sampling integration; @Caroline mock dashboard tiles by EOW. I'll coordinate with the partner for canary.

deploy-bot: Deployed feature-flag scaffold to prod for `obs_per_route_v1` — use `console/flags` to enable per org.

Matt: I'll take backend. Looping in @Leo for S3 budgeting.

Sophia: I'll produce infra estimate and suggested quota thresholds by Friday.

Elena: Thanks team — we'll sync Fri 9am PT for go/no-go.
